title: Employee Scheduling Result v4.0 - SISQUAL WFM import payload
description: What a solver produced, in the shape SISQUAL WFM ingests. Unlike the problem schema, this one keeps SISQUAL's own PascalCase vocabulary verbatim: the problem format is a spec we co-design, so we assert correct spelling there; this is their existing import API, so we conform to it. Specified by JSON-Import.docx (from WFM's viewpoint "Import" means data coming IN, i.e. our output). A result does not restate the problem - it references it by RosterCode, EmployeeCode, Date and ScheduleCode, so the cross-checks live in src/schema_v4/validate_result.py, not here. Standalone: this file does not reference any other schema.

OutRosterTeamDays.description: One entry per employee per planned day.

RosterCode.description: The quadro. Must match the problem's metadata.rosterCode.

TeamCode.description: Org grouping. Renders as the Nr column in the WFM roster grid.

EmployeeCode.description: JSON-Import.docx says string, but SISQUAL's own sample emits an integer. Both are accepted; validate_result.py warns when it does not match the problem's string ids by type.

Date.description: The spec says YYYY-MM-DD; the sample emits naive YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS at midnight. Both are accepted.

ScheduleCode.description: The chosen shift, referencing the ScheduleCode catalogue (schedules.dataFile). Sentinels: 1 = Espaco, 3 = Day off, 4 = Vazio.

OutRosterTeamDayTasks.description: Intra-shift task allocation. Empty in every sample seen; SmarTask does not populate it yet.

OutRosterTeamDayResponsibilities.description: The second assignment axis. Empty in every sample seen.

OutScheduleUseds.description: Definitions of the shifts referenced above - the result-side twin of the ScheduleCode catalogue. Optional: SISQUAL's own sample omits it, relying on codes already known to WFM. Supply it when a result uses codes WFM may not hold.

DayType.description: 0 WeekDay (dia de trabalho), 1 WeekEndSaturday (folga complementar), 2 WeekEndSunday (folga obrigatoria), 3 Empty (V folga).

ScheduleWeight.description: Paid length of the shift. JSON-Import.docx labels it h/dia but JSON-Export.docx and the catalogue spreadsheet both use MINUTES; the catalogue's ScheduleWeightMinutes settles it as minutes.

StartDate1.description: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS. First leg of the shift.

StartDate2.description: Second leg - present only for a split shift.
